collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-14  -  THE STRANDED CRAB SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: Two children find a small crab trapped beneath a fallen basket near the shore.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two children find a small crab trapped beneath a fallen basket near the shore.

choices.label: Ask an Older Villager for Help.
Clear Nearby Debris Without Touching the Crab.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The crab scuttles toward the water while the children watch from a distance.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The crab remains motionless briefly before moving into the shade.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The older villager frees the crab and shows how to avoid its claws.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: By the time help arrives, the crab has escaped through a narrow opening.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The crab finds a route out, and the children leave it undisturbed.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The basket remains wedged, so the children seek assistance.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The children discover that the crab is already working its way free.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The crab appears unable to escape, prompting the children to fetch help.
